components.second_half_kickoff: play block of half 2 starts at frame 113742 published in the organisers FAQ.md; frames 110808-113741 written D (organiser statement; not measurable externally)
components.registration: possession-v2.9 (possession/register.py): broadcast ball registered through shared players and smoothed, before the accuracy gate
components.goalkeeper_team_correction: possession-v2.11 (possession/keeper2.py): goalkeeper track pieces found under the id of the team that does not defend their goal are moved to the defending team in the tracking the models see (whole half: most of the goal's evidence is under the other id; shorter: the piece continues a goalkeeper piece); noise gate, broadcast alignment, registration and accuracy gate use the ids as given

selection.rule: all six registered gates passed on 8 external validation copies: simulated goalkeeper id errors, and a simulated camera that does not always show the far goalkeeper
selection.earlier_candidate: possession-v2.10 (possession/keeper.py; possession-v210-plan.json, possession-v210-results.json) passed its four gates and was not released: it moved outfield players when the far goalkeeper was not tracked

evidence_limits: the errors and the camera window were simulated by us; whether the provided tracking has them was not looked at. The output is the output of possession-v2.9 unless a goalkeeper track piece is found in a slot of the other team
